title: Answer: no account of free will, and an alter's volition is a phenomenal content dissociated from the rest

statements.text: Analytic idealism takes no position on whether the will is free or on what agency is. Volition enters only as one more phenomenal content of an alter. Because the volition of an alter is dissociated from the rest of cosmic consciousness, alters cannot change the laws of nature, and the shared world runs independently of personal volition. That is why the world seems autonomous from the dissociated perspective of an alter.
statements.scope: the 2018 paper The universe in consciousness, the fullest statement of the view in this folder
